species: Since virulence factors form a large constituent of the protein content in bacteria-derived EVs, we next characterized the cargo proteins of the B. cereus EVs by liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS) to screen for virulence factors.
disease_state: the enteropathogenic B. cereus strain NVH0075-95 was grown in LB broth for 17 h at 30 °C and pelleted vesicles were visualized by transmission electron microscopy (TEM).
sample_source: Since virulence factors form a large constituent of the protein content in bacteria-derived EVs, we next characterized the cargo proteins of the B. cereus EVs by liquid chromatography–tandem mass spectrometry (LC–MS/MS) to screen for virulence factors.
strain: Here, we investigate the production and characterization of enterotoxin-associated EVs from the enteropathogenic B. cereus strain NVH0075-95 by using a proteomics approach and studied their interaction with human host cells in vitro.
